title: Downloadable v0.1
scope: Owner-authorized Gate 5 implementation and parallel qualification. Local macOS arm64 only; communication provider operations, public ingress, deployment and publication remain separate. Acceptance requires current behavior evidence and actual owner review.

acceptance.title: A usable first run
acceptance.proof: A developer outside the author’s checkout installs the candidate, starts a persistent local server, resolves two identities, exchanges a message and file in both directions, and reconnects without lost history. No provider account or private bootstrap file is required.
acceptance.observation: Public setup fixtures exchange messages and files and recover history after restart. Candidate 0d285d168509 has archive-inventory and selected archived reference/contact evidence; these automated observations do not constitute an independent developer first run.
remaining: Complete matching installed qualification for the selected final candidate.
Record the required independent fresh-user journeys; zero attempts are recorded.

acceptance.title: Give an agent presence
acceptance.proof: Install the supplied MCP configuration and skill into the qualified Codex host using one ordinary revocable identity. Share a draft, receive the human’s reply, consume it explicitly, and continue the exact saved session after restart. Also answer independently initiated contact. Report the actual resume mode; do not imply automatic model wake.
acceptance.observation: The public agent installation and scripted/offline journey have scoped evidence. The Gate 5 actual-model lane has not run; host login and runner tests do not prove inference or exact saved-session continuation.
remaining: Obtain the matching passing package prerequisite.
Run the explicitly selected actual-model journey: same normal credential, exact saved-session resume, explicit reply consumption and independent contact.
Record independent human use and final review.

acceptance.title: Make an app reachable
acceptance.proof: The separate review app uses only public interfaces to ask for a decision and answer an incoming request. The developer installs it without editing Connect internals. Restart both processes; recover the inbox and preserve one logical business effect and reply.
acceptance.observation: The public connected-app journey records outgoing review, incoming requests, exact replay and recovery of the original app ledger and business effect. Installed attempts include scoped app checks; an overall matching installed pass remains absent.
remaining: Reconcile the app proof with the final selected candidate and complete its installed envelope.
Observe the app journey in independent fresh-user walkthroughs.

acceptance.title: Two-party video on named paths
acceptance.proof: On the approved profile, distinct clients exchange decoded moving video and duplex audio through Connect: browser↔browser, native QUIC↔browser, and native QUIC↔native QUIC. Prove negotiation, invitation rejection, access, camera mute, peer loss and teardown. Audio and video remain separate streams in the same Session and Conversation. Unsupported routes reject video explicitly.
acceptance.observation: Named native and browser paths have real decoded-media and failure/recovery evidence. The approved impaired-browser requirement remains failed: sparse browser sending prevents the required cadence or AV observations. The direct-Chrome clean/loss/jitter controls are diagnostics with distinct profiles, not qualification.
remaining: Resolve impaired browser sending without changing the approved limits.
Pass all required matching decoded paths and failure/recovery scenarios, then the installed media envelope.

acceptance.title: A reference client developers can learn from
acceptance.proof: A person can select a permitted contact, inspect available routes, exchange messages/files, accept or reject voice/video, mute camera or microphone, and see delivery and recovery state. The reference client uses public SDK/API behavior, has keyboard-accessible controls, and works at narrow and desktop widths without exposing provider credentials.
acceptance.observation: Candidate 0d285d168509 includes the contact-selection repair. Its archived real-browser reference check passed all 11 general checks and all 13 AV/continuity checks. A separate private augmentation passed five contact-browser checks using archived assets and the public local API. Earlier three-regression failures and the 216-test source proof remain recorded; these selected checks are not a complete installed pass.
remaining: Complete the matching full installed envelope and independent human walkthroughs.
Requalify any later affected reference-client changes against the selected final candidate.

acceptance.title: A contributor adds a connector
acceptance.proof: A contributor following the shipped guide implements an independently owned fixture connector with a capability/configuration manifest and passes the common harness. Cover messages/context and a bounded voice lifecycle fixture. Explicit composition registration is allowed; core conversation, authorization and routing logic are not edited.
acceptance.observation: A separate reviewer built the Prism connector from the exported public kit without core policy edits. Both public-kit fixtures passed their 40-check contracts and cold-build checks; the successful source baseline includes host integration. This is a separate-agent contribution exercise, not a fresh-user human walkthrough.
remaining: Reconcile the final candidate contribution surface and remaining source/dependency review.
Retain explicit fixture-only and unsupported live-provider/video boundaries at acceptance.

acceptance.title: Provider lifecycle remains explicit
acceptance.proof: The extension contract represents readiness, external identifiers, verified callbacks, accepted/delivered/failed/uncertain results, start/end and reconciliation without provider-name branches in core logic. Qualify reordered/duplicate events, uncertain creation, restart and cleanup. Map Vapi/Telnyx to the contract; do not force SMS into a call abstraction.
acceptance.observation: Normalized message and voice lifecycles, stale/duplicate observation handling and uncertainty have component and full-source regression evidence. Vapi/Telnyx mappings preserve channel-specific semantics. Current shared transport changes are not covered by historical live-provider acceptance merely because provider method bodies are unchanged.
remaining: Complete claim-by-claim provider compatibility review for the final graph.
Keep changed unqualified provider claims blocked unless separate qualification is authorized and recorded.

acceptance.title: An independent UCTP client interoperates
acceptance.proof: A separately written client using a different protocol implementation reads the published profile, negotiates and authenticates over real QUIC, resolves an identity, exchanges permitted requests/events, resumes its cursor and replays one mutation safely. It must not invoke Connect’s Rust helper/client or rvoip’s UCTP implementation. Include incompatible-version, malformed-envelope and unauthorized-operation cases; use shared vectors, not shared parser code.
acceptance.observation: The standalone aioquic client implements its own parser and uses real verified QUIC. Retained installed evidence passed six vector tests and all 26 control checks, including restart/replay and negative authority/framing cases, before an unrelated later installed failure. This covers reliable control, not an independent media stack.
remaining: Bind the retained control evidence to the final candidate composition and complete the required installed envelope.
Retain exact implementation, version, TLS and independence boundaries in final review.

acceptance.title: One honest interface matrix
acceptance.proof: Publish and execute the operation/transport matrix for Rust, Python, TypeScript, HTTP/JSON, CLI and MCP. Equivalent operations preserve authority, IDs, errors and replay semantics. Explicitly label the Python/TypeScript native helper and browser WebRTC path. Tools control sessions; they do not carry media frames. Unsupported combinations remain visible.
acceptance.observation: Public interface tests compare durable IDs, outcomes, errors and current-authority replay for contacts and AV Session controls. Python/TypeScript native transport uses the declared helper; browser media uses WebRTC. Session control parity does not prove decoded media or actual-model use.
remaining: Requalify interfaces affected by current source changes and complete matching installed checks.
Keep unsupported transport combinations visible; resolve separate browser and actual-model acceptance.

acceptance.title: Setup is recoverable and understandable
acceptance.proof: Choose existing resources or preview proposed changes, keep secrets out of clients/logs, and resume interrupted setup without duplicate purchases or resource creation. Qualify locked/missing secret storage, rejected credentials, uncertain provider results and separate inbound/outbound readiness using local fixtures. Contact ownership and SMS enrollment are separate states; neither a saved number nor a valid API key establishes consent.
acceptance.observation: Local fixtures cover public setup, preview/resume, readiness and uncertainty; secret-storage tests include isolated native Keychain failure and recovery. Contact ownership remains distinct from SMS enrollment. Automated setup evidence is separate from user comprehension.
remaining: Complete the matching installed setup/secret-storage envelope.
Measure independent first-run usability and record all failures and interventions.

acceptance.title: One conversation survives channel changes
acceptance.proof: Messages and an artifact establish context; voice/video sessions reuse that Conversation; an attributable outcome supports a later message after restart. Retain source references, omissions and incomplete-transcript state. A bounded leg ending does not close the Conversation. Only explicit developer intent creates a new Conversation; ambiguous inbound binding cannot silently split or merge it.
acceptance.observation: The 0d285d168509 archived reference check passed all 13 AV/continuity checks, including source-backed decisions, artifact re-verification and attributed follow-up after restart in the original Conversation. Source references, omissions and incomplete-transcript status remain explicit. This does not substitute for the unrun actual-model continuation.
remaining: Complete the matching full installed envelope and actual-model exact-session follow-through.
Retain source attribution and omission limits when reviewing final continuity claims.

acceptance.title: Revocation, SMS rules and data recovery hold
acceptance.proof: Recheck current authority on replay, queued dispatch and active resource use. Verify denied cross-conversation access, artifact integrity/retention, HELP/STOP/START, cancellation that START cannot revive, and provider uncertainty. Upgrade a populated previous schema, restore a verified backup and exercise rollback/refusal without deleting the database or replaying live media.
acceptance.observation: Source regressions cover current authority, replay, SMS suppression and artifact/data recovery. The aa31 archive passed the affected historical recovery and mute checks. Historical migrations, synthetic fixtures and later scoped repairs retain distinct provenance; no live media replay is inferred.
remaining: Complete the matching full installed recovery/security envelope after current source changes.
Review final compatibility and retention claims against the exact candidate.

acceptance.title: Measured operating and usability limits
acceptance.proof: Publish versions, network/media profiles, concurrency, queue/size/retention limits and measured startup/setup times with reproducible procedures. Meet the approved video profile and retain audio/recovery bounds. Run fresh-user walkthroughs and bounded loss/load/interrupt tests; distinguish forwarding latency from end-to-end provider/model delay and measured values from targets.
acceptance.observation: The separate 0d285d168509 exploratory 60-second two-native-pair run observed 5.10–5.32 changing fps across four participants, below the 24 fps clean-profile comparison. It does not extend the supported one-pair profile or establish capacity. Browser impairment remains unqualified. No independent fresh-user attempt is recorded; the walkthrough JSON is a blank template.
remaining: Meet the unchanged approved media operating profile.
Record three independent fresh users with installation and prerequisite time separated from the ten-minute local reply target.
Publish measured values with their actual profile and scope; do not substitute diagnostic treatments for required checks.

acceptance.title: Current release evidence is complete
acceptance.proof: Run the full candidate source and installed-package suites, required ignored cases and agent/app journeys at identified revisions. Keep offline, actual-model and historical provider evidence separate. Review every changed provider path against its previous live proof; changed unqualified behavior blocks its release claim until separate qualification is authorized and recorded. Retain failures and unresolved checks.
acceptance.observation: Clean 66115d2 passed all 84 source phases; later changes have explicitly scoped composition/repair evidence. Candidate 0d285d168509 includes the contact UI repair and passed selected archived reference/contact checks. There is no matching complete installed pass, and the actual-model lane is unrun. Later evidence annotations do not change the archive’s recorded source boundary.
remaining: Reconcile the selected final source and affected artifacts using reviewed composition or a new complete source run.
Obtain matching installed, media and actual-model evidence; retain every earlier failed attempt.
Finish provider and independent quality review before acceptance.

acceptance.title: A reproducible package and contribution surface
acceptance.proof: A clean machine can install the versioned server, SDKs/helper, examples, MCP/skill and reference client from the documented distribution. Publish hashes, dependency/patch provenance, license notices, protocol/profile versioning, release notes and migration instructions. Required source and qualification inputs are publicly reproducible; a private historical executable or owner-review supplement cannot be an unexplained prerequisite.
acceptance.observation: The 0d285d168509 local archive is built and inventory-verified with pinned source/patch and license provenance, including the contact-selection repair. Selected archived reference/contact checks passed. Inventory and selected diagnostics are not a clean-machine or complete installed acceptance claim.
remaining: Select the final source and preserve matching runtime, source and qualification archives; requalify any later affected changes.
Complete installation and qualification using matching reproducible assets and exact provenance.
Finish release/migration documentation and final contribution-surface review.

acceptance.title: Owner review precedes publication
acceptance.proof: All A5 criteria and F-01–F-21 commitments have current evidence or an explicitly reviewed source-composition record, with no unresolved release blockers. The owner reviews the candidate and exact compatibility claims. Only a separate publication instruction permits uploading release artifacts or updating the public project claims. Gate 5 stays release-ready, not released, until publication is verified.
acceptance.observation: This is an unsealed progress record. All 16 criteria remain not-qualified. Failed browser impairment and incomplete installed/model/human evidence prevent final owner handoff. No publication has been performed or authorized by this report.
remaining: Resolve every release blocker and reconcile all acceptance and feature commitments.
Obtain actual owner review of the exact candidate and compatibility claims.
Treat any future publication as a separate instruction and verified action.
